name: anti-tangent-mcp
description: Anti-tangent MCP server companions: the anti-tangent-protocol on-demand protocol plugin, the bm-scribe Basic Memory note-writing plugin, and I/O-delegation hooks (anti-tangent-shunt for bulk reads, anti-tangent-guard for task-session and completion enforcement and comment hygiene, which also refuses a dispatched implementer's edits before validate_task_spec (and, opted in, any session's) and Edit/Write calls that add comments carrying change history).

plugins.name: anti-tangent-protocol
plugins.description: On-demand loader for the anti-tangent-mcp drift-protection protocol. A description-triggered skill that loads only the role-scoped protocol part a task needs, and only when a task with acceptance criteria appears, from a plan or a spec — keeping the always-loaded footprint to one line.

plugins.name: bm-scribe
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin that writes Basic Memory notes per v0.7.0 project-knowledge conventions and the BM v0.21.1 three-step permalink-canonicalization pattern.

plugins.name: anti-tangent-shunt
plugins.description: Routes I/O-heavy implementer work to a cheap worker model via PreToolUse hooks. Intercepts oversized Read and Bash calls, delegating them to anti-tangent-mcp's bulk_read tool to keep the implementer's context small and token-efficient.

plugins.name: anti-tangent-guard
plugins.description: Five hooks enforcing anti-tangent-mcp's conventions (six registrations: the stop check is registered on both Stop and SubagentStop). A PreToolUse hook on Edit/Write/NotebookEdit refuses a dispatched implementer's first edit until validate_task_spec has been called; with ANTI_TANGENT_EDIT_GATE=subagents or all (off by default) it refuses edits to project files in every subagent, or every session including the main one, until that session has made its own successful validate_task_spec call, exempting paths outside the session cwd and ANTI_TANGENT_EDIT_GATE_EXEMPT globs (default docs/**/*.md). Under the same switch, a Stop/SubagentStop hook asks a session to call validate_completion before it stops when its validate_task_spec opened a task it has edited and nothing closed, once per stretch of edits. A PostToolUse hook on TaskUpdate mandates the validate_completion gate when a protocol task closes, blocks a full-protocol close whose completion ran with no task session, and, when the evidence that call submitted adds comments carrying change history, returns a blocking instruction to reopen and fix — reading the submitted diff, or a final_files completion through git, which reports nothing for work already committed. It detects rather than prevents: PostToolUse fires after the state change. A PreToolUse hook on Edit/Write refuses such a comment before it is written. A PostToolUse hook on Edit/Write/NotebookEdit asks a task once for a check_progress call when it reaches ten edits since validate_task_spec without one; it refuses nothing. Set ANTI_TANGENT_TICKET_PATTERN to your tracker's key shape to have tracker keys caught. Kill switches: ANTI_TANGENT_SESSION_GUARD=0 (fingerprinted start gate and no-session close rule), ANTI_TANGENT_COMPLETION_GUARD=0 (TaskUpdate completion gate only), ANTI_TANGENT_COMMENT_GUARD=0 (comment scan, both hooks), ANTI_TANGENT_PROGRESS_GUARD=0 (progress reminder), ANTI_TANGENT_STOP_GUARD=0 (stop check only).
